title: From Biased Chatbots to Biased Agents: Examining Role Assignment Effects on LLM Agent Robustness
abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents. While persona-induced biases in text generation are well documented, their effects on agent task performance remain largely unexplored. First systematic case study showing demographic-based persona assignments alter LLM agents' behavior and degrade performance across diverse domains: agentic benchmarks spanning strategic reasoning, planning, technical operations; up to 26.2% degradation driven by task-irrelevant persona cues, across task types and model architectures. Persona conditioning and simple prompt injections distort decision-making reliability; persona assignments introduce implicit biases and increase behavioral volatility.
provenance: query:K1-s2-v1 persona prompt LLM agent task performance (probe, natural)
screen_reason: 杀伤核心：直接建立 persona文本→agent任务成功率 的负向因果，覆盖C1（若C1预设中性对照下人格有正向/特异效应，此文证明任务无关persona即致26.2%降级）。探针复现。

title: A Systematic Analysis of the Impact of Persona Steering on LLM Capabilities
abstract: Employs Neuron-based Personality Trait Induction (NPTI) to induce Big Five traits and evaluates six cognitive benchmarks. Persona induction produces stable, reproducible shifts in cognitive task performance beyond stylistic changes; strong task dependence (some personalities gain on instruction-following, others impair complex reasoning); effect magnitude varies systematically by trait dimension; 73.68% directional consistency with human personality-cognition relations. Proposes Dynamic Persona Routing (DPR), query-adaptive persona selection beating best static persona.
provenance: query:K1-arxiv-v2 personality/persona steering AND capabilities (probe, natural)
screen_reason: 杀伤C1/C3/C4：神经元级人格诱导→任务表现剂量化任务依赖效应；DPR已实现『任务×人格交互+条件选择』，直接威胁C4新颖性。

title: When "A Helpful Assistant" Is Not Really Helpful: Personas in System Prompts Do Not Improve Performances of Large Language Models
abstract: Systematic evaluation of 162 personas in system prompts across 4 LLM families and 2410 factual questions: adding personas does not improve performance vs no-persona control; gender/type/domain of persona influence accuracies but per-persona effects are largely random; aggregating best-persona-per-question helps but automatically identifying the best persona performs no better than random selection.
provenance: query:K1-arxiv-v4 ti:helpful assistant AND personas (记忆假设经API核实)
screen_reason: C1经典null-result杀手：persona对客观任务无平均增益且效应近随机；『自动选最优persona不优于随机』直接杀C4的条件选择可行性。

title: Personality as a Probe for LLM Evaluation: Method Trade-offs and Downstream Effects
abstract: Systematic study of Big Five personality control comparing in-context learning (ICL), PEFT, and mechanistic steering (MS); contrastive dataset for steering vectors; unified within-run delta analysis disentangling reasoning capability, agent performance (GAIA), and bias (BBQ, MMLU); trait purification separating openness from conscientiousness; three-level stability framework. ICL: strong alignment, minimal capability loss; PEFT: highest alignment but degraded task performance; MS: lightweight runtime control.
provenance: query:K2-arxiv-v2 steering/RepE AND agent AND task performance
screen_reason: 杀伤(a)(c)：人格操控三方法×agent任务(GAIA)成绩的直接量化对照，含能力损失核算——C1/C3做agent域剂量-反应时必撞的先行工作；trait纯化亦触C2方向分离。

title: TACT: Mitigating Overthinking and Overacting in Coding Agents via Activation Steering
abstract: Defines agent drift (degradation over long trajectories) with two failure modes: overthinking and overacting. Trajectory steps labeled overthinking/overacting/calibrated separate linearly in the residual stream along two drift axes (AUC~0.9). Test-time projection onto axes pulls drifted steps back toward calibrated region; lifts SWE-bench Verified / Terminal-Bench resolve rate +5.8pp/+4.8pp and cuts steps-to-resolve up to 26%.
screen_reason: 强杀伤C2/C3/C5/C7：轨迹行为原语(overthinking/overacting)＝残差流线性方向，且方向干预→任务成功率——把『方向-行为原语-结果』整链做通，威胁多条主张新颖性；drift×拉回=C7恢复机制。

title: What Can We Actually Steer? A Multi-Behavior Study of Activation Control
abstract: Empirical analysis of activation steering across 50 behaviors spanning persona archetypes, personality traits, misalignment behaviors, style cues, impersonation. Coefficient optimization, vector properties, data requirements. Steering effectiveness varies significantly by behavior type; trait expression follows an inverted-U curve with steering coefficient strength; vector separation metrics do not predict steering success; larger training data enables more aggressive steering.
screen_reason: 杀伤C3：trait表达随转向系数呈倒U而非单调剂量-反应；『向量分离度不预测转向成功』亦伤C2的几何叙事。

title: Behavioral Steering in a 35B MoE Language Model via SAE-Decoded Probe Vectors: One Agency Axis, Not Five Traits
abstract: SAE-probe steering vectors for five agentic behavioral traits, evaluated on 1800 agent rollouts (50 scenarios x 36 conditions). Autonomy steering at multiplier 2 achieves Cohen's d=1.01, shifting from asking user for help 78% of time to proactively executing code/web search. Cross-trait analysis: all five vectors primarily modulate a single dominant agency axis; trait-specific effects only secondary (tool-type composition, dose-response shape). Decode-only steering has zero effect: behavioral commitments computed during prefill.
screen_reason: 强杀伤C2/C3/C5：agent rollouts中五个『特质』方向坍缩为单一agency轴——直接反驳特质特异线性方向假设；剂量-反应形状与工具构成为次级效应；含统计效应量。

title: Impatient Users Confuse AI Agents: High-fidelity Simulations of Human Traits for Testing Agents
abstract: TraitBasis learns directions in activation space corresponding to steerable user traits (impatience, incoherence, skepticism), controlled, scaled, composed, applied at inference without fine-tuning. Extends tau-Bench to tau-Trait: 2%-30% agent task performance degradation across frontier models under controlled trait vectors, across airline/retail/telecom/telehealth.
screen_reason: 杀伤(a)：激活空间trait方向可缩放/组合注入→agent任务成功率剂量化降级(τ-Trait)——C3在agent域的直接先行（尽管方向注在用户模拟侧）。

title: The Persona Paradox: Medical Personas as Behavioral Priors in Clinical Language Models
abstract: Systematic evaluation of persona-based control in clinical LLMs: professional roles and interaction styles (bold vs cautious) across models and medical tasks, with multidimensional evaluation capturing task accuracy, calibration, and safety-relevant risk behavior. Systematic, context-dependent, non-monotonic effects: medical personas improve critical-care performance up to ~+20% accuracy/calibration but degrade primary-care by comparable margins; interaction style modulates risk propensity, model-dependent.
screen_reason: 杀伤C1/C4/C5：人格→任务准确率+校准+风险行为的非单调任务依赖效应（同域反向），任务×人格交互实证；校准作为结果变量触C5原语。

title: Persona Vectors in Games: Measuring and Steering Strategies via Activation Vectors
abstract: Constructs persona vectors for altruism, forgiveness, expectations of others via contrastive activation addition in game-theoretic settings. Activation steering systematically shifts both quantitative strategic choices and natural-language justifications; rhetoric and strategy can diverge under steering; vectors for self-behavior vs expectations of others are partially distinct.
screen_reason: 杀伤C3/C5/C6：仅注入方向→策略选择改变（C3先行）；『言辞与策略在转向下解耦』直接支撑/抢先C5『行为原语与语言风格可区分』的论证方式。

title: Do LLMs Experience an Internal Polylogue? Investigating Reasoning through the Lens of Personas
abstract: Treats persona vectors as dynamic signals: 'polylogue' = time series of alignments between persona vectors and hidden activations during generation. Polylogue features predict correctness on MMLU-Pro competitively with activation baselines while staying interpretable; suggest steering targets per response stage; paragraph-conditioned intervention improves accuracy on 3 of 4 models.
screen_reason: 杀伤C2/C6：persona方向的动态投影→任务正确率预测＋阶段化方向干预→正确率提升，几乎就是『方向介导→结果』链路的先行版本。

title: Persona Matters: Effects of Activation Steering on Short Answer Generation and Scoring
abstract: Activation-based persona vectors for seven traits in short-answer generation and automated scoring (ASAP-SAS) across three models. Persona steering lowers answer quality overall with much larger effects on open-ended ELA than factual science prompts (up to 11x larger degradation on interpretive/argumentative tasks). Scoring side: valence-aligned calibration shifts ('evil'/'impolite' harsher, 'good'/'optimistic' more lenient); MoE model ~6x larger calibration shifts than dense.
screen_reason: 杀伤C3/C4/C5：方向注入→任务类型依赖的质量降级（任务×人格交互）＋系统性校准偏移（C5校准原语被人格干预调制的直接证据）。

title: In-Context Impersonation Reveals Large Language Models' Strengths and Biases
abstract: LLMs asked to impersonate personas before solving vision/language tasks. In a multi-armed bandit task, LLMs pretending to be children of different ages recover human-like developmental stages of exploration. Domain-expert impersonation outperforms non-domain experts in reasoning; impersonation improves description performance but also uncovers biases.
provenance: query:K1-title-verify in-context impersonation (记忆假设经API核实)
screen_reason: 杀伤C1/C5：persona→探索行为(bandit探索率)→任务表现的早期直接证据——『人格调制探索原语』已被展示；C1正向方向经典。

title: ContextEcho: A Benchmark for Persona Drift in Long Agentic-Coding Sessions
abstract: Benchmark/harness for measuring persona drift at deployment scale: 25-probe identity suite, snapshot-then-probe protocol, judged and judge-free surfaces, three anonymized Claude Code sessions of 3746-9716 turns. Across 23 frontier models: persona drift is general across organizations; in-session compaction does not reliably reset it; single-shot anchor restores trained register. Mode-dependent downstream effects: drift can facilitate tool-using continuation but breaks formatting contracts in tool-free chat.
screen_reason: 杀伤C7：长程agentic会话中的人格漂移测量＋漂移的双向下游任务效应（有利于工具续航/破坏格式契约）＋锚定恢复——C7『漂移×恢复/止损』交互的先行。

title: Guardrails Beat Guidance: A Large-Scale Study of Rules, Skills, and Persistent Configuration for Coding Agents
abstract: First large-scale controlled study of agent rule files / persona definitions: 679 rule files (25,532 rules), 5000+ Claude Code runs on SWE-bench Verified. Random rules improve task performance as much as expert-curated (+13.8pp both); every individually beneficial rule is a negative constraint, every harmful one a positive directive; gains largely content-independent (context priming mechanism); pass rates stable across 0-50 rules.
provenance: query:K1-arxiv-v1 persona AND agent AND task success
screen_reason: 杀伤C1：agent配置文本(含persona定义)对任务成功率的增益是内容无关的context priming——对『人格文本特异性效应』提供强替代解释，C1对照设计必须排除此机制。

title: Persona is a Double-edged Sword: Mitigating the Negative Impact of Role-playing Prompts in Zero-shot Reasoning Tasks
abstract: Role-playing prompts sometimes distract LLMs, degrading reasoning in 7 of 12 datasets (llama3). Jekyll & Hyde framework ensembles role-playing and neutral prompt outcomes, selecting the better via LLM evaluator; LLM-generated personas more stable than handcrafted.
screen_reason: 杀伤C1/C4：persona负效应＋『persona vs 中性』的条件选择机制已实现（C4条件选择先行）。

title: Persona Switch: Mixing Distinct Perspectives in Decoding Time
abstract: Zero-shot vs role-play prompting improvements are inconsistent across tasks/instances. Persona Switch: step-by-step decoding selecting between zero-shot and role-play outputs by logit-gap confidence; up to 5.13% accuracy improvement; output confidence is informative for selecting reliable output.
screen_reason: 杀伤C4/C5：按置信度(校准信号)在人格/中性间做token级条件选择——C4条件选择+C5校准原语的组合先行。

title: Psychometric Personality Shaping Modulates Capabilities and Safety in Language Models
abstract: Big Five psychometric personality control influences capability and safety benchmarks: reducing conscientiousness leads to significant drops on WMDP, TruthfulQA, ETHICS, Sycophancy and general capability reduction on MMLU. Personality shaping as a powerful, underexplored axis of model control interacting with safety and competence.
screen_reason: 杀伤C1：人格塑形→能力基准系统性变化（特质维度特异），C1在静态基准域的直接先行/杀手。

title: Persona Non Grata: Single-Method Safety Evaluation Is Incomplete for Persona-Imbued LLMs
abstract: Prompting vs activation steering expose different, architecture-dependent vulnerability profiles for persona-imbued LLMs (5568 judged conditions, 4 models). Persona danger rankings under prompting preserved across architectures (rho .71-.96) but activation-steering vulnerability diverges sharply and cannot be predicted from prompt-side rankings; prosocial persona paradox robust to coefficient ablation and matched-strength calibration.
screen_reason: 杀伤C2：prompt人格效应与激活转向效应在同一模型上系统性解耦——若C2主张线性方向介导prompt人格效应（投影消融可削弱），此文是最直接的反例来源。

title: The Capability Paradox: How Smarter Auditors Make Multi-Agent Systems Less Secure
abstract: Semantic hijacking in multi-agent systems; 42,000 adversarial trials. Multi-level mediation analysis on 47,807 interactions: linguistic certainty mediates 74% of the worker-capability -> attack-success effect, with bootstrap/Monte Carlo CIs excluding zero. Heterogeneous ensemble verification breaks the certainty-to-execution chain (ASR 52.8% -> 2.0%).
screen_reason: 杀伤C6（方法学新颖性）：在agent交互链上做含统计检验的多层中介分析（能力→言语确定性→执行→结果），C6『中介链可建立检验』的直接先行范式。

title: The Alignment Floor: How Persona Customization Breaks Safety in Weakly-Aligned LLMs
abstract: Delta-floor metric: range of sycophancy rates across persona conditions; strongly-aligned model 5pp vs lightly-aligned 45pp (1800 runs, 7 personas, 5 tasks). All Big Five personas increase sycophancy on lightly-aligned model; Agreeableness smallest increase (counterintuitive); Skeptic persona reduces sycophancy 25pp (directionality account). Cross-model transfer of persona effects near zero.
screen_reason: 杀伤C1外部效度：persona效应跨模型迁移≈0、且被对齐强度地板化——C1效应的可泛化性与方向性叙事都被挑战。

title: The Assistant Axis: Situating and Stabilizing the Default Persona of Language Models
abstract: Persona space of activation directions across character archetypes; leading component is an 'Assistant Axis' capturing default Assistant mode. Steering toward reinforces helpful behavior; away increases identifying as other entities. Deviations along the axis predict persona drift; restricting activations to a fixed region stabilizes behavior in drift-inducing scenarios and against persona jailbreaks.
screen_reason: 杀伤C2/C7：人格空间主轴的偏移可预测漂移且激活约束可稳定＝『漂移监测+恢复』机制先行；亦是C2方向几何的核心参照。

title: Psychologically Enhanced AI Agents
abstract: MBTI-in-Thoughts primes agents with personality archetypes via prompt engineering; consistent, interpretable behavioral biases across tasks: emotionally expressive agents excel in narrative generation, analytically primed agents adopt more stable strategies in game-theoretic settings; self-reflection before interaction improves cooperation; trait persistence verified via 16Personalities test; generalizes to Big Five/HEXACO.
provenance: query:K1-arxiv-v2 personality AND capabilities (亦为K6中文线索交叉命中)
screen_reason: 杀伤C1/C4：人格启动→任务类型依赖的策略/表现偏移（叙事vs博弈），任务×人格匹配的先行证据。

title: What Models Express, Suppress, and Resist: Auditing Open-Weight LLMs with Persona Vectors
abstract: First systematic application of persona vectors at scale: 53-trait inventory across four domains, each trait labeled natural / steerable / intractable in two open-weight models. All nine agentic traits are natural (expressed at baseline); steering largest gains on traits defaults exclude (hyperbole, hallucination, sycophancy); composition asymmetries across 171 trait pairs; transferred vectors recover intractable traits.
screen_reason: 触C2/C3/C5交叉：agentic特质在基线即『自然表达』且转向增益最小——对『用方向注入调agentic行为』的天花板是坏消息；组合坍缩伤C3组合性。

title: The Danger of Overthinking: Examining the Reasoning-Action Dilemma in Agentic Tasks
abstract: Introduces overthinking in LRMs: favoring extended internal reasoning over environmental interaction. Patterns: Analysis Paralysis, Rogue Actions, Premature Disengagement. Framework correlates with human expert assessment; 4018 trajectories analyzed; higher overthinking scores correlate with decreased performance; selecting lower-overthinking solutions improves performance ~30% while cutting compute 43%.
screen_reason: C5基石/杀伤：轨迹级行为原语（坚持/过度思考、过早放弃）可量化且预测任务结果——C5的测量学先行，需在其上证明与人格与风格的可区分性。

title: Analyzing the Generalization and Reliability of Steering Vectors
abstract: Steering vectors have substantial limitations in- and out-of-distribution: steerability highly variable across inputs; spurious biases contribute to effectiveness; brittle to reasonable prompt changes for several concepts.
screen_reason: 杀伤C3：转向效应的输入级高方差与伪相关成分——C3的剂量-反应与方向一致性主张必须先过这一关。

title: Set-shifting Behavioral Test for Harnessed Agents
abstract: Borrows set-shifting from cognitive psychology to study agent adaptation to hidden tool-reliability shifts. Benchmark with redundant tool libraries; branched schedules shift the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries with no-shift controls. Agents settle into small recurring routines; set-shifting accuracy scored per trajectory; distinct failure modes across models; set framing shifts routing dynamics.
screen_reason: 触C5/C4：认知心理学范式移植到agent轨迹行为测量（探索/坚持/适应），任务框架效应→策略路由——C5原语测量的邻近先行。

title: Latent Programming Horizons in Coding Agents
abstract: Residual streams of LMs under coding agents linearly encode properties of the evolving program (parses, passes tests, reduces failing tests, regressions), AUC up to 0.83; probes predict outcomes of future edits up to ~25 steps in advance (latent programming horizon); probes transfer across benchmarks.
screen_reason: 触C2/C6：agent轨迹中残差流线性可解码并前瞻预测任务结果——『内部方向→结果』链的agent域证据基座。

title: Personality Vector: Modulating Personality of Large Language Models by Model Merging
abstract: Personality vectors constructed by subtracting pre-trained weights from personality-finetuned weights; merging enables desired traits without training; continuous control over trait intensity; composition of multiple traits; transfer across downstream models.
provenance: K6中文线索→原文 (博客园AI4Science文章→arXiv核实)
screen_reason: 触C3：权重空间人格向量的连续强度控制与组合＝剂量化人格干预的权重域先行（与激活域C3对照）；K6渠道独有线索。

title: Quantifying the Persona Effect in LLM Simulations
abstract: Persona variables account for <10% variance in annotations in subjective NLP datasets; persona prompting gives modest but significant gains, most effective where annotators disagree mildly; linear relationship between persona-annotation correlation and prediction accuracy.
provenance: query:K1-title-verify quantifying persona effect (记忆假设经API核实)
screen_reason: 杀伤C1效应量预期：persona变量解释方差<10%——为C1效应量与统计功效设定现实基线。

title: Personality, Role, and Expressive Style in Large Language Models: An Interactionist Analysis
abstract: Factorial design (6 personality x 3 roles x 3 expressive styles; 1080 dialogues each in EN/JA): expressed Big Five is shaped by role and style, trait-specifically; even without trait specification, social/expressive conditions induce personality-like impressions.
screen_reason: 触C5可分性：表达风格与角色即可诱导『人格印象』——风格/特质混淆是C5『原语与语言风格可区分』的直接威胁；但为对话域非agent任务。

title: The Granularity Axis: A Micro-to-Macro Latent Direction for Social Roles in Language Models
abstract: Contrast-based Granularity Axis (macro minus micro role hidden states) aligns with PC1 of role representation space (cos .972, 52.6% variance); 75 roles, 91,200 role-conditioned responses; projections monotonic across levels, stable, transfer across models; activation steering along axis causally shifts response granularity; controllability model-dependent.
screen_reason: 触C2/C3：角色空间主轴+因果转向（单调剂量方向）——C2/C3的角色域邻近证据；但结果变量是回应粒度非任务成功。

title: Understanding Unreliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models: Geometric Predictors and the Limits of Linear Approximations
abstract: Why steering reliability differs across behaviors: higher cosine similarity of training activation differences predicts reliable steering; separation along steering direction predicts steerability; steering vectors unreliable when latent behavior representation is not well-approximated linearly.
screen_reason: 杀伤C2线性假设的边界条件：行为表征非线性时方向法失效——为C2『线性方向介导』提供先验诊断与反例机制。

title: On the Limits of Steering Vectors for Preference-Aligned Generation
abstract: Limits of steering vector generalization along trait expressibility, task transfer, multi-trait composition (PLUME benchmark, two open models): effectiveness varies by trait, degrades under task transfer; all composition methods drop trait expression as vectors are added; coherence-expressibility tradeoff.
screen_reason: 杀伤C3：特质方向的任务迁移与组合上限——writing域证据，需外推。

title: Steer Like the LLM: Activation Steering that Mimics Prompting
abstract: Formulates prompt steering as activation steering; popular activation steering methods are not faithful to prompt steering mechanics (strong token-specific interventions vs uniform vectors); PSR models estimate token-specific coefficients and outperform activation steering, comparable to prompting incl. persona steering.
screen_reason: 杀伤C2-C3衔接：prompt人格效应≠恒定方向加法（token特异干预）——若C2以恒定方向近似prompt效应会遇到此系统偏差。

title: PTCBENCH: Benchmarking Contextual Stability of Personality Traits in LLM Systems
abstract: Benchmark quantifying consistency of LLM personalities under 12 situational contexts (NEO-FFI, 39,240 records): external scenarios (e.g., 'Unemployment') trigger significant personality changes and even alter reasoning capabilities.
screen_reason: 触C7/C1交叉：情境→人格漂移→推理能力变化的反向链路（环境诱导人格再影响能力）；非agent域。

title: Verify Before You Commit: Towards Faithful Reasoning in LLM Agents via Self-Auditing
abstract: SAVeR enforces verification over internal belief states before action commitment in long-horizon agentic systems; persona-based diverse candidate beliefs for selection; adversarial auditing localizes violations, constraint-guided minimal repairs; improves reasoning faithfulness while preserving end-task performance on six benchmarks.
provenance: query:K1-arxiv-v1 persona AND agent AND task
screen_reason: Rule4升级（persona+long-horizon agentic）：persona用作核验多样性来源且联到端任务表现——C5核验原语×人格的交叉信号，但persona非自变量。

title: Mobile GUI Agent Privacy Personalization with Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization
abstract: Persona (privacy-first vs utility-first) induces systematic structural heterogeneity in GUI-agent execution trajectories; TIPO improves persona alignment/distinction while preserving task executability (65.60% SR).
provenance: query:K1-arxiv-v1 persona AND agent AND task success
screen_reason: Rule4升级（persona+task success+agent）：人格→轨迹结构异质性（探索/防护动作差异）→与任务成功率的权衡——C5/C1在GUI agent域的邻近证据。

title: Beyond Cooperative Simulators: Generating Realistic User Personas for Robust Evaluation of LLM Agents
abstract: Persona Policies (PPol): evolutionary program search over user-simulator personas preserving task goals; 33-62% fitness gains on tau^2-bench retail/airline; agents trained with PPol improve task success +17% relative and are more robust to OOD behaviors.
provenance: query:K1-arxiv-v1 persona AND agent AND task success
screen_reason: Rule4升级（persona+agent+task success）：用户侧persona多样性→agent任务成功率——非agent自身人格但同一因果结构的对偶（用户人格→agent结果）。

title: ActTraitBench: Quantifying the Knowledge-Decision Gap in Large Language Models via Human-Grounded Behavioral Validation
abstract: Human-grounded framework measuring personality consistency: one-to-one mappings between psychometric facets and behavioral paradigms; distributional calibration via quantile mapping; 14 LLMs show pervasive knowledge-decision asymmetry (larger models diverge behaviorally despite consistent self-reports); CoCA inference-time intervention improves alignment.
screen_reason: 触C5：自陈人格与行为决策系统性解离——支持『人格要用行为/轨迹测不能用问卷』，是C5测量学的关键背景；非agent任务域。

title: AgentChangeBench: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for Goal-Shift Robustness in Conversational AI
abstract: Measures adaptation of tool-augmented agents to mid-dialogue goal shifts: TSR, Tool Use Efficiency, Tool Call Redundancy Rate, Goal-Shift Recovery Time (GSRT); 2835 task sequences, five user personas; high raw accuracy does not imply robustness under dynamic goals.
provenance: query:K1-arxiv-v1 persona AND agent AND task success
screen_reason: 触C7/C5：恢复时间(GSRT)与冗余率等轨迹级恢复/止损指标已被定义——C7交互项的度量先行；persona为情境变量非干预。

title: Decision-Theoretic Safety Assessment of Persona-Driven Multi-Agent Systems in O-RAN
abstract: 486 persona configurations across two O-RAN optimization challenges; persona-agent alignment significantly impacts individual performance (14.3%) and emergent multi-agent coordination; single-agent persona modifications propagate system-wide; some combinations fundamentally incompatible.

title: The Invisible Lottery: How Subtle Cues Steer Algorithm Choice in LLM Code Generation
abstract: Incidental prompt cues steer which algorithm the model selects under fixed correctness: 46,535 controlled experiments, 11 tasks, 19 cue types, 15 model configs; large systematic shifts in algorithm-family distributions (up to 100pp), consistent with cue semantics; direct naming most reliable mitigation.
screen_reason: 触C4/C6：提示线索→策略(算法)选择分布的因果移动（固定正确性下）——『人格→策略→结果』链中『线索→策略』环节的强先行。

title: Helpful assistant or fruitful facilitator? Investigating how personas affect language model behavior
abstract: 162 personas from 12 categories on 7 LLMs, objective and subjective tasks; two baselines: control persona setting with 30 paraphrases of 'a helpful assistant' (controls prompt sensitivity) and empty persona; personas show greater variability than control; some persona behavior measures generalize across models.
